content_sections.heading: AIIMS Mangalagiri Faculty Recruitment 2026 Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: Vacancies are distributed across 33 departments and four faculty grades: Professor, Additional Professor, Associate Professor, and Assistant Professor. Category-wise breakup (UR: Unreserved, OBC: Other Backward Classes, SC: Scheduled Caste, ST: Scheduled Tribe) is provided for each department. Abbreviations: UR - Unreserved, OBC - Other Backward Classes, SC - Scheduled Caste, ST - Scheduled Tribe, EWS - Economically Weaker Sections. 4% horizontal reservation posts are reserved for Persons with Benchmark Disability (PwBD). # Denotes an anticipated vacancy. For the Department of Trauma & Emergency Medicine, the qualifying discipline for the Professor post is MD in Emergency Medicine / MD in Medicine / MS in General Surgery, and for the Assistant Professor post it is MD in Emergency Medicine / MS in General Surgery / Trauma Surgery / MS in Orthopaedics / MD in Paediatrics. The notification clarifies that the above vacancies are provisional and subject to variation, and the Executive Director, AIIMS Mangalagiri, reserves the right to vary vacancies, including reserved vacancies, as per Government of India rules, circulars, and requirements.

content_sections.heading: AIIMS Mangalagiri Faculty Recruitment 2026 Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Qualification requirements differ by post and by candidate category (medical or non-medical). A summary is given below; candidates should refer to the official notification for the complete text applicable to their post and department. For non-medical candidates, the Master's degree required is discipline-specific: M.Sc. (Human Anatomy) for Anatomy, M.Sc. (Medical Physiology/Physiology) for Physiology, M.Sc. (Medical Biochemistry/Biochemistry) for Biochemistry, and M.Sc. (Medical Pharmacology/Pharmacology) for Pharmacology, along with a doctorate degree from a recognized university. Candidates holding a DNB qualification in broad specialties or super-specialty must produce documentary evidence of DNB equivalence with MD/MS/DM/M.Ch as per the MCI notification dated 31.10.2018. Depending on the training institution category under that notification, 1 to 2 years of additional experience may be required. Teaching and/or research experience is counted only from recognized institutions in the subject of speciality; experience in Dental, Physiotherapy, or Nursing colleges is not considered for eligibility. Experience will be counted as on 31st December 2026, subject to verification of documentary evidence. Age relaxation is available as follows: 10 years for Persons with Benchmark Disabilities, 5 years for SC/ST post-reserved candidates, 3 years for OBC post-reserved candidates, and 5 years for Government servants as per DoPT instructions. No age relaxation is available to SC/ST/OBC/EWS candidates applying against unreserved vacancies. For deputation applicants, the maximum age is 56 years for posts other than Professor and 58 years for the post of Professor, as on the last date of receipt of application. Note: Reservation does not apply to posts filled on a deputation basis. Candidates should ensure that they meet the prescribed age limit as on the specified cut-off date. You can use our Age Calculator to check your exact age and confirm your eligibility before applying.

faq.question: Q1. What is AIIMS Mangalagiri Faculty Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: It is a recruitment drive by All India Institute of Medical Sciences, Mangalagiri, Andhra Pradesh, to fill 79 Faculty (Group-A) posts of Professor, Additional Professor, Associate Professor, and Assistant Professor on Direct Recruitment/Deputation basis across 33 departments, notified vide AIIMS/MG/Admin/Recruitment/03/Faculty/2026/01 dated 11.08.2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in AIIMS Mangalagiri Faculty Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: A total of 79 posts are available: 17 Professor, 11 Additional Professor, 14 Associate Professor, and 37 Assistant Professor posts across 33 departments. The vacancies are provisional and subject to change by the institute.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for AIIMS Mangalagiri Faculty Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The closing date of online applications is 45 days from the date of publishing in the Employment Newspaper; the exact calendar date is not specified in the notification. The hard copy of the application must reach the institute within 10 days of the online closing date.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification for AIIMS Mangalagiri Faculty Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Medical candidates generally need a recognized medical qualification plus a postgraduate degree (MD/MS), and/or D.M./M.Ch. for super-specialities, along with the prescribed years of teaching/research experience that vary by post. Non-medical candidates need a relevant Master's degree and a Doctorate degree, with prescribed experience after the doctorate. Full details are given in the Eligibility section above.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for AIIMS Mangalagiri Faculty Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The maximum age is 58 years for Professor and Additional Professor, and 50 years for Associate Professor and Assistant Professor, as on the closing date of online application, with age relaxation applicable as per rules for PwBD, SC/ST, OBC, and Government servant candidates.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee for AIIMS Mangalagiri Faculty Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The fee is Rs. 3,100 (Rs. 3,000 + Rs. 100 processing fee) for UR/EWS/OBC candidates, Rs. 2,100 (Rs. 2,000 + Rs. 100 processing fee) for SC/ST/Women candidates, and Rs. 100 (processing fee only) for PwBD candidates, who are exempted from the application fee.

faq.question: Q7. How can I apply online for AIIMS Mangalagiri Faculty Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Applications must be submitted online through the AIIMS Mangalagiri website, which will open the application portal shortly, followed by sending a signed hard copy of the application and supporting documents to the Recruitment Cell within 10 days of the online closing date, and emailing self-attested documents as a single PDF to [email protected].
